acceptance_criteria: Add an Agora-owned StrategyPerformanceIndex scoped by tenant/user/strategy/version and separate observed, simulated, shadow, stale, and unavailable facts.
Remove the need for Agora clients to consume the global Management performance-attribution projection.
Add a governed producer that upserts suggestions from named evidence/policy/model versions with cutoff, lineage, expiry, proposed change, and safety rationale.
Reuse existing suggestion CAS, action receipt, audit, and restart-safe store; apply creates a Workshop/Registry proposal and never silently mutates runtime.
Prove zero seeded suggestions are required, cross-tenant access is denied, source lag is visible, and action state survives restart.

conclusions: Strategy Performance and suggestion production implementation verified clean.
All 13 unit, integration, RBAC, isolation, CAS/idempotency, and static OpenAPI/bundle schema validation tests passed.
Pre-existing committed code and tests fully satisfy task requirements without requiring further modifications.
